programme.title: Avinash
programme.desc: Avinash, a singer and a dealer of stolen goods, finds his life turned upside down when some goons break into his house and assault his fiancee.

programme.title: Dhongee
programme.desc: Chandran lies to his boss that his mother is unwell to get a leave but gets caught. In order to save his job, he is forced to pretend to his boss that he has a good-for-nothing twin brother.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Krishna Arjun
programme.desc: Sharda Yadav, a widow, lives with her two sons, Krishna and Arjun. Arjun is studying in Mumbai when he hears that his mother has passed away and Krishna has been arrested for raping a widow.

programme.title: Kundan
programme.desc: Shamsher Singh, who is involved in criminal activities, decides to get the better of Kundan, a police officer, after realising that he is a threat to him.

programme.title: Mela
programme.desc: Best mates Kishen and Shankar decide to help village belle Roopa avenge her family's death, but their friendship is tested in the process.

programme.title: Naach Govinda Naach
programme.desc: Govinda, an aspiring dancer, lives with his poor mother. In a turn of events, he is given a break to compete with Rocky, a famous dancer in the city.

programme.title: Aulad
programme.desc: Believing his wife to be dead, Anand gives up his own child to Yashoda, who has lost her husband and her baby. However, he faces a dilemma when his wife returns.

programme.title: Naya Din Nayi Raat
programme.desc: Sushma, a young girl, runs away from home to escape an arranged marriage. On her way, she meets many people, each representing a distinct facet of human nature, who help her in her difficulties.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Mera Faisla
programme.desc: Raj wishes to marry Rati but faces humiliation from her father due to the stigma associated with his lineage. Soon, he decides to join the police force to restore his family's honour.

programme.title: Majaal
programme.desc: Vijay falls in love with Sadhana and marries her, but on several occasions, he is disrespected by his in-laws. Frustrated, he loses interest in his married life.

programme.title: Sikka
programme.desc: Vijay and Pranlal, two close friends, decide to marry off their kin in a bid to cement their friendship. Soon, Vijay learns about Pranlal's illegal activities and calls off the wedding.

programme.title: Gurudev
programme.desc: Inspector Dev Kumar has to choose between arresting his childhood friend Guru's father, who is a notorious criminal, and his integrity.

programme.title: International Crook
programme.desc: Rajesh, a superintendent of the police, is happy to meet his old friend Shekar in Goa, unaware that he is a smuggler who is involved in a spree of illegal activities.

programme.title: Race
programme.desc: Two stepbrothers own a huge stud farm and a horse racing business. When they learn that they have a common love interest, one of them tries to kill the other and inherit the insurance money.

programme.title: Ek Aur Prem Deewani
programme.desc: After falling in love with her music teacher, a princess wishes to break off her engagement with a US-based man. As a result, her wedding day turns out to be full of unexpected events.

programme.title: Nakshatra
programme.desc: Ajay works on a new script, which is based on a robbery of an expensive necklace, for some producers. However, things take a turn when the scene is enacted in real-life and the blame falls on Ajay.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: Sikandar Sadak Ka
programme.desc: Sikander, an honest union worker, is harassed and sent to jail when he tries to stop the unscrupulous activities of his evil employer. After he gets released, he sets out to destroy him.

programme.title: Zakhmi Aurat
programme.desc: Inspector Kiran Dutt is brutally raped by Sukhdev and Suryakant. When they are acquitted by the court due to lack of evidence, she decides to take the law in her own hands.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Ghar Mein Ram Gali Mein Shyam
programme.desc: Amar weds a village belle and they move to the city where she meets her neighbours Mr and Mrs Dharamchand. Soon, Amar begins to doubt her fidelity and Dharamchand devises a scheme to separate them.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Aaj Ka Mahaatma
programme.desc: Randhir, a straightforward and hardworking man, sets out to avenge the death of his twin brother Ranvir, a criminal, who was murdered by a prison inmate.

programme.title: Ajab Gazabb Love
programme.desc: Rajveer, a rich man, falls in love with Madhuri. However, he soon realises that she detests affluent people and in order to win her heart, he, along with his family, pretends to be poor.

programme.title: The East
programme.desc: A former FBI agent working for a private security firm is sent to infiltrate an anarchist movement behind a series of actions against corrupt corporations. programme.title: Flubber
programme.desc: A scatty professor is in financial trouble, and his only hope of avoiding disaster is to market his latest invention - a strange rubbery substance with a life of its own. However, a criminal gang is determined to get hold of his creation. Remake of 1961 Disney comedy The Absent-Minded Professor, with Robin Williams, Marcia Gay Harden, Christopher McDonald and Wil Wheaton.

programme.title: Bambi
programme.desc: A young deer grows up in the forest, forming close friendships with other woodland creatures. When tragedy strikes, he is suddenly forced to fend for himself but ultimately becomes brave and resourceful enough to save his friends during a forest fire. Animated drama, with the voices of Bobby Stewart, Hardie Albright and Donnie Dunagan.

programme.title: Mulan
programme.desc: A girl poses as a man so she can take her ailing father's place in the army and join in the battle against invading forces - a move that ensures her fame as a national hero. Disney animated adventure based on a Chinese folk tale, featuring the voices of Ming-Na, Eddie Murphy, BD Wong and Miguel Ferrer.

programme.title: The Chronicles of Narnia: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Four children are evacuated from London during the Second World War and sent to a rural manor house where they discover a secret entrance to the mystical world of Narnia. There they help vanquish the wicked White Witch, whose curse has gripped the land in perpetual winter. Fantasy adventure based on the book by CS Lewis, with Tilda Swinton, Georgie Henley, Skandar Keynes, Anna Popplewell, William Moseley, James McAvoy and Jim Broadbent, and featuring the voice of Liam Neeson.

programme.title: Hercules
programme.desc: The son of Zeus, king of the Greek gods, is sent to Earth to be raised as a human. When he learns of his immortal heritage, he discovers he can only reclaim his position among the gods by becoming a true hero, so he embarks on a series of adventures and battles fearsome monsters to prove his worth. Disney animated adventure, with the voices of Tate Donovan, Danny DeVito, James Woods and Rip Torn.

programme.title: A Bug's Life
programme.desc: Well-meaning ant Flick lands his colony in trouble when he accidentally disposes of an offering meant for a swarm of greedy grasshoppers - who promptly promise a horrible revenge. Faced with the imminent destruction of the anthill, he sets out to save the situation by enlisting the help of a few would-be heroes - an out-of-work troupe of bugs from a low-rent flea circus. Pixar animation, with the voices of Dave Foley, Kevin Spacey and Julia Louis-Dreyfus.

programme.title: Aladdin
programme.desc: A street urchin is caught up in a scheming grand vizier's plot to get his clutches on a magical lamp. Retrieving the object from a wondrous cave, he releases a powerful genie trapped inside, whose ability to grant wishes helps the young hero thwart the villain's plans and woo a princess. Animated adventure, featuring the voices of Robin Williams, Scott Weinger and Linda Larkin.

programme.title: Frozen
programme.desc: A princess with the power to freeze anything she touches loses control of her abilities and plunges the kingdom into a perpetual winter. She goes into hiding, but her sister remains determined that she can be saved from her own magic and sets off on a quest to find her, aided by a mountain man and a living snowman. Disney animated fantasy adventure, with the voices of Kristen Bell and Idina Menzel.

programme.title: Monsters, Inc
programme.desc: Two monsters work for an energy firm that employs scary creatures to sneak into children's bedrooms and convert their screams into power. However, when a little girl accidentally wanders into the pair's domain, they have to race against time to return her safely home before anyone finds out. Animated comedy, with the voices of John Goodman, Billy Crystal, Steve Buscemi and James Coburn.

programme.title: Percy Jackson: Sea of Monsters
programme.desc: The modern-day teenage son of the Greek god Poseidon must lead his friends on a perilous journey into the Bermuda triangle. They need to recover the legendary Golden Fleece to save the world, but getting to it means braving all manner of terrifying monsters. Fantasy adventure sequel, starring Logan Lerman and Alexandra Daddario.

programme.title: Ant-Man
programme.desc: A thief attempting to go straight is recruited by a scientist who provides him with a suit that gives him the power to shrink. He must use his new skills to carry out a special mission - helping the inventor to steal back his miniaturisation technology from a ruthless businessman who intends to turn it into a deadly weapon. Superhero adventure, starring Paul Rudd, Michael Douglas and Evangeline Lilly.

programme.title: Bad Company
programme.desc: A secret agent is murdered, leaving his veteran CIA partner to transform the dead man's streetwise twin from an uncouth hustler into a credible replacement for his brother, so the agency can continue its investigation into a diabolical terrorist plot involving a nuclear bomb. Comedy thriller, starring Anthony Hopkins, Chris Rock, Peter Stormare, Gabriel Macht and John Slattery.

programme.title: A Real Pain
programme.desc: Mismatched cousins David and Benji reunite for a tour through Poland to honour their beloved grandmother. Comedy drama, starring an Oscar and Bafta-winning Kieran Culkin, and Jesse Eisenberg, who also directed and won a Bafta for Best Original Screenplay.

programme.title: Nightbitch
programme.desc: A nameless stay-at-home Mother tends to her young son in the suburbs while Husband casually goes out to work. Trapped in a whirlpool of rage and frustration about the loss of her identity, Mother becomes convinced that she is turning into one of the dogs that roam the neighbourhood. Dark comedy adapted from Rachel Yoder's novel, starring Amy Adams and Scoot McNairy.

programme.title: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Dog Days
programme.desc: Weedy youngster Greg finds his plans for a lazy school holiday ruined when his mother bans video games and his father organises a series of family activities. When he finds out a girl he likes is working at a country club, he tells his family he has a summer job there as an excuse to spend time with her - but struggles to keep up the deception. Family comedy sequel, starring Zachary Gordon and Steve Zahn.

programme.title: DuckTales the Movie: Treasure of the Lost Lamp
programme.desc: Scrooge McDuck and great-nephews Huey, Dewey and Louie lead an archaeological expedition to find a long-lost genie's lamp once belonging to a notorious bandit, but reckon without a villainous attempt to use its powers in a dastardly plot. Animated adventure, with the voices of Christopher Lloyd, Alan Young and Russi Taylor.

programme.title: The Parent Trap
programme.desc: Identical twin sisters who are unaware of each other's existence meet by accident. They decide to join forces in a bid to reunite their estranged parents, and switch places to get the warring couple to kiss and make up. Remake of the 1961 Disney comedy, starring Dennis Quaid, Natasha Richardson, Elaine Hendrix and Lindsay Lohan in a dual role.

Pixar animated adventure sequel, with the voices of Owen Wilson and Michael Caine.

Animated comedy from the director of The Incredibles, with the voices of Patton Oswalt, Ian Holm, Lou Romano and Peter O'Toole.

programme.desc: S12 E2 — Sandra & Toni-AnnSeventy-year-old Sandra is a self-professed 'crazy camel lady' and is looking for a mature fella to ride off into the sunset with. Toni-Ann from London is pansexual, pens erotic literature and dreams of being the heroine in her own sexy novel.

programme.title: Gogglebox
programme.desc: S17 E12On the box this time are 'SAS: Who Dares Wins', 'Dragons' Den', 'Three Families', 'Headspace: Guide to Sleep', 'Secret Crush', 'Lego Masters USA', 'This Morning', and 'BBC News (holidays)'.

programme.title: Below Deck
programme.desc: S12 E5 — Rainbeau Kisses, Friendship WishesFraser begins to question his long distance relationship. Rainbeau tries to connect with Barbara and Solene. Caio's shortcomings as bosun are playing on Captain Kerry's mind. And Kyle and Solene go on a date.

programme.title: Abbott Elementary
programme.desc: S2 E5 — JuiceJanine is thrilled to help introduce a new beverage to the cafeteria, but it ends up causing unexpected consequences; Melissa clashes with her new aide, Ashley, who brings more disruption than help to the classroom.

programme.title: The Simpsons
programme.desc: S9 E8 — Lisa the SkepticDuring a school archaeological dig, Lisa finds the skeleton of an angel on the site where a new shopping mall is to be built. Homer takes it home and, while the experts argue over its validity and the clerics its divinity, people flock to see it until one day the angel flies away.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S2 E10 — The Pontiac Bandit ReturnsThe Pontiac Bandit is back in custody, where his knowledge of a Giggle Pig dealer earns him a plea deal. Gina and Boyle worry their parents are getting too close, and Santiago makes Holt a Christmas present.

programme.title: Brooklyn Nine-Nine
programme.desc: S2 E11 — StakeoutCharles and Jake's relationship is impacted during an eight-day stakeout in close quarters. Elsewhere, Rosa takes notice of Capt. Holt's nephew.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: S2 E10 — SocialGordon visits Social, a restaurant in Costa Mesa, California, to revamp the premises, creating a space that's warm and welcoming to attract well-heeled local patrons.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: S2 E23 — See You Next FallIn this penultimate instalment a chain of events, including Botox throwing a tantrum or two, may mean that the family misses Alex's graduation from middle school.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: S2 E24 — The One That Got AwayJays demands to have a quiet birthday, but his family just can't resist planning a huge party. In the mad dash to organise the event, Claire and Mitchell wind up trapped at their childhood home.

programme.title: Rude(ish) Tube
programme.desc: ShortsA short, cheeky clip from Rude Tube's naughty little sister, featuring sports of the lawnmower, motorcycle and bicycle variety.

programme.title: Couples Come Dine with Me
programme.desc: Worthing & PortsmouthThe first hosts are pensioners Bill and Hilary, with an evening of classic dishes, day two sees Doug and Patsy host with a combination of fine dining and hippie happenings, and finally it's time for youngsters Micaela and Sanchez to impress.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Botto's Italian Line RestaurantThis Italian restaurant, in Swedesboro, New Jersey, is in debt and serving dreadful food - some that would result in food poisoning. Gordon arrives to give the venue some much-needed culinary education.

programme.title: Gordon Ramsay's 24 Hours to Hell and Back
programme.desc: S3 E5 — Seafarer's Family RestaurantChef Ramsay descends upon a Virginia based seafood restaurant situated right off a busy highway that isn't seeing much business these days. Seafarer's is run by two sisters, Amber and Autumn Halterman, who are always at war with each other.

programme.title: Below Deck
programme.desc: S12 E5 — Rainbeau Kisses, Friendship WishesFraser begins to question his long distance relationship. Rainbeau tries to connect with Barbara and Solene. Caio's shortcomings as bosun are playing on Captain Kerry's mind. And Kyle and Solene go on a date.

programme.title: Modern Family
programme.desc: S11 E9 — The Last ChristmasMitchell suspects Cameron has an ulterior motive for keeping everyone happy for Christmas dinner. Claire tries to dodge Jay's job offer to work at his dog bed company. Luke has to deal with the consequences of kissing Manny's ex-girlfriend Sherri.

programme.title: James Martin Delicious
programme.desc: S1 E5 — AsparagusJames prepares asparagus tart, poached egg with asparagus, char grilled asparagus with red pepper and visits a local grower.

programme.title: James Martin Delicious
programme.desc: S1 E6 — SpanishTime for chick pea and spinach tapas, Andalusian pork, charred tuna romesco and Iberian ham salad. Then James pays a visit to Borough market in London to track down the best Spanish ingredients.

programme.title: James Martin Delicious
programme.desc: S1 E7 — CheeseJames Martin cooks cheese with roast figs and prosciutto, baked cheese in a box and a classic Greek salad. Then he visits Lyburn Farm to see how cheese is made.

programme.title: James Martin's French Road Trip
programme.desc: S1 E1 — ConcarnauJames Martin invites the Hairy Bikers to stay in his trailer before descending on the market at Concarneau, which is well stocked with fresh seafood, meat, vegetables and other treats.

programme.title: The Hairy Bikers' Northern Exposure
programme.desc: S1 E1 — PolandFor two sausage-loving bikers, Poland is the ultimate destination. Si and Dave make sausages in the Polish countryside with a family who have been making them for generations, and also visit the home of gingerbread and Copernicus.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S9 E8 — Chicken in BulkRee Drummond's hitting the mark on a major bulk buy trip and stocking up on chicken breasts, ready to turn into a fantastic Cobb salad, a skillet chicken lasagna, cool crisp Thai lettuce wraps and feel-good chicken rice soup.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S9 E9 — Football, Football, FootballRee Drummond whips up chicken nachos two ways for the family to eat after the homecoming parade. Then she's off to her boys' football game armed with chocolate chunk cookies.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S9 E13 — Stacking the Hay and Stocking the FreezerWhile the family's stacking hay, Ree Drummond's stocking up the freezer with her family's favourite dishes, including chicken enchiladas, his and hers pizza pockets, three cheese-stuffed shells and purple smoothie popsicles.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: S9 E11 — Kitchen Confessional: ChocolateRee Drummond's spilling the cocoa beans on her love for all things chocolate such as Ladd's chocolate pie, delicious chocolate message cookies, a totally retro chocolate fondue, and even chocolate-covered potato chips.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S8 E1 — Cookbook PartyThe delightful Ina Garten reveals her cooking tips. Ina cooks a celebratory feast to mark the completion of her book. Her menu consists of a tasty lamb dish and a decadent angel food cake for dessert.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S8 E2 — Night Before DinnerIna creates an in-the-fridge meal that fits in around busy schedules. On the menu is a delicious roast loin of pork with fennel stuffing, cauliflower gratin, green vegetables and a pumpkin parfait with ginger biscuits.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S3 E1 — CakesTwelve of the country's best amateur bakers test their skills. In the first round, the bakers tackle an upside-down cake for their signature bake, before the demanding technical challenge has them trying out Paul Hollywood's recipe for rum babas. Finally, the cooks attempt to produce a showstopping cake with a hidden design detail, but who will impress the judges, and who will be the first to leave?

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S3 E2 — BreadIn the first round, the bakers make two varieties of flatbread, before tackling the technical challenge in which they undertake Paul Hollywood's recipe for the notoriously difficult eight-strand plaited loaf. Finally, in the showstopper challenge, the contestants endeavour to make twelve sweet and twelve savoury bagels. Presented by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins.

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Pasta: The Stuff of LifeSophie cooks orecchiette pasta at home and makes pasta with chickpeas for friends outdoors. She visits a pottery famed for its colourful pasta ceramics.

programme.title: Sophie Grigson: Slice of Italy
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Bread and PizzaSophie learns about the traditional taralli biscuits made of wine and olive oil. She also searches for the ideal pizza and prepares her own in the outdoor pizza oven.

programme.title: Jamie's 5 Ingredient Mediterranean Meals
programme.desc: S1 E1Jamie Oliver presents easy recipes that use just five ingredients to deliver maximum flavour, from a genius way to cook chicken, to pie with the easiest dough ever, and a treat from the Godfather of Spanish cuisine, José Pizarro.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E9 — RetroGuy Fieri rolls out to some legendary joints around America where time has stayed still, like the Californian '40s take-out burger joint or the Portland café with '50s style red vinyl booths.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E10 — Worth the TripGuy travels far and wide in search of amazing food including a diner located on Bainbridge Island in Seattle, ribs from Mo Gridders BBQ in the Bronx, and pinto beans from Harold's Café in Gaffney, South Carolina.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E11 — Diners A-PlentyGuy Fieri tries lobster rolls, Philly cheesesteaks and hits up a diner in South Carolina where the speciality is the A-Plenty, a meal or sandwich covered in French fries and onion rings.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: S1 E12 — American Cookin'Guy checks out a diner in Rockford which has as incredible beef and egg noodle dish. Then he heads to a place in St. Paul where amazing Italian food is brought direct to diners in their cars.

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: S5 E4 — Pardon My FrenchThe owner of Chapeau! in San Francisco investigates complaints that his wait staff is rude to customers.

programme.title: Mystery Diners
programme.desc: S5 E5 — OktobertheftThe co-owner of Speisekammer in Alameda, Calif., fears the German Dirndl Girls hired by her ex-husband are causing more harm than good.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: S15 — Gargoyles, Pineapples & Packing Momma's ApartmentA novelist celebrating his new book wants a giant gargoyle cake for his party. The team creates a grotesque ghoulish creature.

programme.title: Cake Boss
programme.desc: Nutcracker, Gingerbread & Carlo's Christmas CarolIt's Christmastime and to celebrate, Buddy creates a Nutcracker themed cake for a ballet company performing the holiday classic.

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown

programme.title: Delicious Miss Brown
programme.desc: S3 E13 — A Sea Island ChristmasKardea Brown makes a traditional Sea Island holiday menu starring Maple-Glazed Cornish Hens. For sides, she makes the Lowcountry staple Limpin' Susan with Shrimp and her Grandma's Green Beans with Potatoes and Smoked Turkey.

programme.title: Jamie's Easy Meals for Every Day
programme.desc: S1 E13 — Baked Mushroom Soup; Cauliflower RemouladeJamie takes mushrooms to a whole new level with his cheesy baked mushroom soup, and gives a classic salad a tasty twist with a cauliflower rémoulade.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S8 E3 — Going, Going, GoneIna goes under the hammer for a charity benefit. Her menu consists of crunchy noodle salad, Asian grilled salmon and for dessert lemon yoghurt cake with blueberry syrup.

programme.title: Barefoot Contessa: Back to Basics
programme.desc: S8 E5 — Breakfast, Lunch and DinnerIna tests out some classic, comforting recipes on her colleagues. First up are strawberry scones, reworked with two new ingredients. Then there's a hearty wild mushroom lasagna, inspired by produce found at her local organic mushroom farm. Finally, there's a simplified shrimp bisque which boasts all the 'wow factor' with only half the effort.

programme.title: The Great British Bake Off
programme.desc: S3 E3 — TartsThings are hotting up as the remaining ten bakers do their best to wow Paul and Mary with some unusual flavour combinations for their tartes tatin. Baking know-how is the all important ingredient for coming through the technical challenge unscathed. Mary's treacle tart seems simple enough, but its lattice top proves to be the undoing of some of the bakers. Presented by Mel Giedroyc and Sue Perkins.

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Flavour Foundations: Bahamian ClassicsChef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. He kicks off his island adventures with the comfort foods at the heart of Bahamian cooking, from 'chicken in da bag' at Bamboo Shack to learning to put his peas before his rice with chef Tevin Kemp. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.desc: S11 E134 — 07/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.desc: S16 E23 — Crewe 3David Dickinson and the team are at Crewe Hall in Cheshire, where Fay Rutter has a deal mapped out and newcomer Laurie Scully faces a regular in the bid for a vintage hat stretcher.

programme.title: Deal or No Deal
programme.desc: S2 E13 — RyanJoin Stephen Mulhern as Ryan gets his opportunity to take on the Banker - he may choose to take an offer from the Banker in exchange for what's in his box or hold out until the end and be rewarded.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: ITV Evening News; Weather
programme.desc: S11 E134 — 07/07/2026A round-up of the day's news headlines and talking points from the UK and around the world.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: Ainsley's Taste of the Bahamas
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Flavour Foundations: Bahamian ClassicsChef Ainsley Harriott explores the vibrant flavours, local producers, markets and unique dishes of the island nation located in the Atlantic Ocean. Then he wraps things up in his beachside kitchen with prawn and coconut fritters served with a pickled coconut slaw.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Seventh Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the seventh round-of-16 match (Kick-off 5.00pm), which takes place at Atlanta Stadium in the USA. The fans in attendance will hope for a more entertaining affair than in the corresponding clash in Al Rayyan four years ago, as Morocco and Spain played out a monotonous 0-0 draw over 120 minutes, in which the Spanish dominated possession but did little with it as few chances were created. The tie came to life in the subsequent penalty shootout as the 2010 champions failed to convert any of their three attempts with goalkeeper Yassine Bounou saving from Sergio Busquets and Carlos Soler after Pablo Sarabia first hit the post, while the Atlas Lions scored three of their four penalties to progress. By missing their three spot kicks, Spain became only the second team to not score in a World Cup penalty shoot-out, following in the footsteps of Switzerland who lost to Ukraine in 2006 by the same 3-0 scoreline.

programme.title: FIFA World Cup 2026
programme.desc: Eighth Round-of-16 MatchCoverage of the eighth round-of-16 match (Kick-off 9.00pm), which takes place at BC Place Vancouver in Canada. The concluding match of this stage four years ago proved to be memorable for several reasons, not the least the final score, as Portugal claimed a comprehensive 6-1 victory over Switzerland. This despite the fact Cristiano Ronaldo was left out of the starting line-up for the first time in a major tournament since Euro 2008 with Gonçalo Ramos making his first start instead, which proved to be a wise move as Ramos became the youngest to score a World Cup hat-trick since Flórián Albert in 1962. Others to get their name on the scoresheet were Raphaël Guerreiro, Rafael Leão, and experienced centre-back Pepe, who became the oldest player to score in the World Cup knockout stage and the second oldest to score at any stage, behind Cameroon's Roger Milla.

programme.title: The Assembly
programme.desc: S2 E1 — Stephen FryStephen Fry faces a grilling from a cast of autistic and learning-disabled interviewers. Did he take drugs in Buckingham Palace? Is he happy to be alive? As the questions come thick and fast, Stephen opens up about mental health, shame and self-criticism. There are probing questions about love, identity and belief, alongside moments of pure mischief and laughter - including an explosive question about his sexual preferences.

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits

programme.title: Mafia's Greatest Hits
